title: Source transport through the common diagonal and the source dualizing factor
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions]. For a separated quasi-compact smooth map g:X→Y of pure relative dimension d, a second such map h:U→Y, a separated etale map e:U→X with e≫g=h, a finite-type structure map aY:Y→Spec k, and a normalized compact-support datum N, construct source(h)≅e*source(g). Factor the self-product map through the pullback of the first diagonal projection. Use inverse counit-normalized etale restriction at the diagonal, then inverse smooth section base change, then the canonical site comparisons. In an etale correspondence j:U→X, v:U→Z with v≫g=j≫f, restrict to O⊆U lying over an affine target open V, with commuting lifts jO and vO. For affine diagonal geometries H,K, define sourceTransport:jO*source(f,H)≅vO*source(g,K) as the inverse source comparison for jO followed by that for vO through h=jO≫fV. It contains neither delta nor a normal-cone map. Finally sourceToDualizing(f,H)=alpha(f,H) followed by rho(f,H) inverse followed by pullback of the coefficient-unit change; this is a map from the source invariant, before deformation, to the restricted ordinary dualizing object. All schemes and arrows and comparison objects use [def-pur-diagonal-counit-comparison-data] and [def-pur-diagonal-etale-section-comparisons].

proof.text: The intermediate map from U×Y U to (X×Y X)×X U is etale: identify it with base change of e along the second projection. Pullback universal properties prove the two projection equations and its diagonal section equation. Separatedness and quasi-compactness follow by cancellation of the structural projection.

Restrict the normalized exceptional-locality mate along the diagonal and compose with inverse smooth section base change and the actual site comparisons. This defines source without any DNC comparison.

Cancel the inclusion V→Y to identify vO≫gV with jO≫fV. These maps are etale; their common composite is smooth of dimension d. Compose the two source comparisons through this common source to define sourceTransport. Define sourceToDualizing from alpha, inverse rho and unitChange.

def sourceTransport (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry f aY d V)
    (K : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry g aY d V)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).obj
        (OrientationRefinement.source P f aY d V H) ≅
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).obj
        (OrientationRefinement.source P g aY d V K)
